item.title: Subsistence
item.description: Subsistence is a sandbox, first person, solo or co-op, PvE open-world survival game. Struggle through changing seasons to build a base, develop technology and gear-up in the hostile environment. Defend yourself from wildlife, the elements and AI hunters (who also build bases in the world).

item.title: Five Nights with Maids
item.description: In this survival horror game, play as a night guard watching over a mansion and its maids for five nights. Use lights, shutters, and cameras to spot suspicious activity. Each night grows more intense as the atmosphere shifts and the maids begin to behave strangely. Can you survive till the end?

item.title: Squad Weapon Skins - Recon Team Pack
item.description: This pack contains 5 woodland weapon skins for the USMC faction.

item.title: Voidtrain - Big Catch
item.description: Catch fish aboard your train, upgrade your gear, and earn Scales with every catch to spend on fishing upgrades and train decor.

item.title: Gear.Club Unlimited 3 - Gear.Club Signature Pack
item.description: Get the Gear.Club Signature Pack and enjoy two exclusive liveries: the Honda S2000 GCU3 Edition and the BMW Z4 GCU Edition. Taking inspiration from Japanese culture, they will transform your cars into works of art!
